description: This is a React component for a dashboard page displaying real-time OEE data including charts, KPIs, and socket connectivity status. It fetches data from APIs, manages WebSocket connections, and renders dynamic visualizations and controls.

methods.name: fmtPct
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with rounding.

methods.name: statusColor
methods.description: Returns a color based on the line status string.

methods.name: shortTime
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp to a localized time string.

methods.name: seedSeries
methods.description: Generates sample OEE data points for chart initialization.
